items.notes: Official Toss Securities Open API guide documents OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials token issuance at POST /oauth2/token. No credentials are stored in this catalog.
Official Toss Securities Open API guide documents GET /api/v1/accounts for account list lookup. Account-scoped calls require Authorization plus X-Tossinvest-Account where applicable.
Official Toss Securities Open API guide documents GET /api/v1/holdings for current holdings lookup. This is read-only asset evidence and not an order endpoint.
Official Toss Securities Open API guide shows GET /api/v1/stocks with symbols query for stock market data. This catalog stores only the path, not query values.
